backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining all data types (WorkInboxItem, Task, ContentPlan, ChannelProfile, Note, FileMetadata) and implementing CRUD operations with per-user storage, access control integration, and blob storage mixin for file management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented file management features including React Query hooks, Files page, upload/download dialogs, and metadata editing with high confidence test coverage.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and utilities with focus on file management, PWA features, notifications, and Persian RTL localization.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Persian language, PWA manifest link, theme color, app icons, and meta tags for installability and SEO.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name in Persian, icons, display mode (standalone), theme colors, RTL direction, and business/productivity categories.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page in Persian with gradient background, icon, message, and retry button shown when network is unavailable.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets, network-first for dynamic content, offline fallback, and automatic cache cleanup on activation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component setting up React Router with routes for dashboard, work inbox, tasks, planner, notes, files, settings, and onboarding, wrapped in ThemeProvider and AuthGate.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Main application shell component providing navigation sidebar, header with user menu, mobile responsive layout, and integrates service worker registration, install banner, and reminders listener.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Authentication gate component that shows login screen for unauthenticated users, profile setup dialog for new users, and renders children for authenticated users with complete profiles.
frontend/src/components/files/FileMetada: Dialog component for editing file metadata including file name and notes fields.
frontend/src/components/files/FileUpload: File upload dialog with drag-and-drop support, file preview, notes field, and handles file upload with metadata creation.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login screen component displaying app branding, feature list, onboarding illustration, and Internet Identity login button.
frontend/src/components/notes/NoteFormDi: Dialog form for creating and editing notes with title and content fields, supporting both add and update operations.
frontend/src/components/planner/ContentP: Dialog form for creating and editing content plans with fields for title, channel selection, content type, and status.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup, collecting user name and saving profile data.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallBanne: Displays a banner prompting users to install the PWA, showing install/dismiss buttons when prompt is available, or a success message when already installed.
frontend/src/components/reminders/Remind: A component that fetches tasks and work inbox items and passes them to the reminders hook for notification scheduling; renders nothing visually.
frontend/src/components/settings/Channel: A dialog form for creating or editing channel profiles with fields for name, channel type (website, Instagram, Telegram, etc.), URL/handle, and notes.
Displays a table of channel profiles with add, edit, and delete functionality, including a confirmation dialog for deletions.
frontend/src/components/settings/ImportE: Provides buttons to export user data as JSON and import data from a JSON file, with confirmation dialog and file metadata handling.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification permissions, displaying current status and providing buttons to request permission or send test notifications.
frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskFormDi: A dialog form for creating or editing tasks with fields for title and priority (low/medium/high).
frontend/src/components/work-inbox/WorkI: Dialog component for creating and editing work inbox items with fields for description, source channel, and status. Integrates with backend mutations and queries for CRUD operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, providing login/logout functionality and identity state management with AuthClient integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, work inbox items, tasks, content plans, channel profiles, notes, and file management.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and RTL text direction support for Persian/Farsi UI.
frontend/src/lib/fa.ts: Persian/Farsi language translations object containing all UI strings for the application including navigation, actions, statuses, and feature-specific labels.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/notifications/useNotificati: Custom hook for managing browser push notifications with permission requests and notification sending functionality, configured for RTL Persian language.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying overview cards for work inbox, tasks, planner, and notes with counts and navigation. Fetches data from multiple queries and filters items by status to show new work items, incomplete tasks, upcoming plans, and pinned notes.
frontend/src/pages/FilesPage.tsx: File management page with upload, download, edit, and delete functionality. Displays files in a table with search filtering, file size formatting, and date formatting in Persian locale.
frontend/src/pages/NotesPage.tsx: Notes management page with CRUD operations, search filtering, and copy-to-clipboard functionality. Displays notes in a grid layout with edit, delete, and copy actions.
Multi-step onboarding wizard that guides users through initial setup by adding their first channel profile and creating example tasks and notes. Features a 3-step progress indicator with skip option.
frontend/src/pages/PlannerPage.tsx: Content planning page with tabbed interface for viewing plans by status and channel. Supports CRUD operations on content plans with status badges (draft, planned, published) and grouping by channel.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings page organizing configuration sections for notifications, channel profiles, import/export, and onboarding revisit. Displays each section in separate cards with descriptions.
frontend/src/pages/TasksTodayPage.tsx: React component for displaying and managing tasks with filtering by completion status, including create/edit/delete operations, priority badges, and completion toggling.
frontend/src/pages/WorkInboxPage.tsx: React component for managing work inbox items with search, status, and channel filtering, displaying items in a table with edit/delete actions and status badges.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers a service worker for PWA functionality, handles periodic update checks, and prompts users to reload when new versions are available.
frontend/src/pwa/usePwaInstallPrompt.ts: React hook that manages PWA installation prompts, detects standalone mode, and provides methods to trigger or dismiss the install prompt.
frontend/src/reminders/useReminders.ts: React hook that checks for overdue tasks and new work items every 5 minutes, sending browser notifications or toast messages and persisting reminder state to localStorage.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, container settings, extended theme with sidebar colors, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file defining a Persian-language web app dashboard for solo small business managers with features for inbox management, tasks, content planning, and Internet Identity authentication. Contains 9 existing features (REQ-1 through REQ-9) covering onboarding, multi-channel communication tracking, and a cohesive visual theme.
